⚠️ Failure Symptom & Factory Service Manual Root Cause

Symptom on machine: The 3D printer emits a loud continuous alarm beep mid-print or during preheat and freezes with 'Thermal Runaway E1: Printer Halted Please Reset'.

Verified technical root cause: Crushed glass bead or broken lead wire on the 100K NTC hotend thermistor (or missing silicone heater block sock allowing the part cooling fan to chill the nozzle).

🔧 Step-by-Step DIY Inspection & Replacement Checklist

  1. Check the idle nozzle temperature on the screen at room temperature: if it reads -14°C, 0°C, or jumps wildly when you wiggle the printhead wire loom, the thermistor wire is broken.
  2. Make sure the silicone sock is covering the aluminum heater block.
  3. Install a new 100K NTC thermistor (or upgraded M3 screw-in brass hex thermistor) without over-tightening the retention screw.

❓ Frequently Asked Questions (E1: Thermal Runaway / Heating Failed Printer Halted)

Why are M3 screw-in brass thermistors better than the stock glass bead on an Ender 3?
The stock glass bead is held by a Phillips screw that easily crushes the fragile PTFE insulation and shorts out. An M3 brass stud thermistor threads directly into the screw hole and never crushes.
